content.short: METCHAIN provides seamless asset mobility and cross-chain application development across metaverse ecosystems.
content.description: METCHAIN is a blockchain network that unites metaverse ecosystems and enables cross-chain interoperability. It gives developers seamless asset mobility and the ability to build cross-chain applications across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Solana, BNB Chain, and Polygon. By connecting these networks, METCHAIN aims to remove interoperability barriers, allowing metaverse assets to move freely and securely between leading chains. This framework supports creators and builders who want to deploy interoperable experiences without worrying about fragmented ecosystems.
